$comment: Restaurant identity and contact details. Fields marked PLACEHOLDER still need confirming with the client — see README.
name: fokia
$comment-phone: Two numbers. `phone` is the landline and is the site's primary number: it is what the server renders, what the JSON-LD advertises, and what a visitor without JavaScript always gets. `phoneAfterHours` is the mobile, swapped in by Contact.astro only when the restaurant is shut. The swap is evaluated against `hours` below in Europe/Athens, NOT in the visitor's own timezone — someone calling from London at 22:00 is calling a restaurant where it is midnight. Change the hours and the swap follows; there is no second copy of the schedule.

address.$comment: Confirmed by the client. `street` and `city` are locale-keyed so the Greek page is not left reading a Latin transliteration of a Greek street name. VERIFY the Greek spellings before launch.

geo.$comment: Supplied directly by the client. Feeds the `geo` block in the JSON-LD, which is omitted entirely if either is null. These sit 1.3m from the marker coordinates inside `mapUrl` — the two are not meant to match to the metre and neither is wrong: mapUrl is Google's own link to the listing and carries Google's marker, while these are the client's own reading. Do not 'reconcile' them by editing the URL.

$comment-mapUrl: Google's documented Maps URLs form (https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/urls/get-started#map-action), addressing the listing by its Place ID. Deliberately NOT the long /maps/place/... URL the browser produces: everything after data= in one of those is length-prefixed — !4m6 declares 'six tokens follow', !3m5 declares 'five' — so dropping a token that looks redundant leaves the counts short and Google silently degrades the link to a name search on the wrong pin, with nothing erroring anywhere. That shipped once. This form has no such structure and nothing safe-looking to delete. The placeId below is the same listing: its base64 decodes to the two 64-bit ids 0x14a1af007ee38927 and 0x9619f033941949e, which are exactly the pair in the !1s field of the client's original share URL. Feeds both the button in FindUs and `hasMap` in the Restaurant JSON-LD.
$comment-mapUrl-provenance: The Place ID inside mapUrl came from the client via Google's Place ID finder, alongside their share link https://maps.app.goo.gl/yBC9YH1GG524MJPWA for the same listing. Neither is stored as a field of its own — the Place ID is already in mapUrl and the share link is not rendered anywhere, and an unused key here is how directionsUrl came to sit in this file unnoticed for months.

hours.$comment: Confirmed by the client. `days` uses schema.org day names for the JSON-LD. List EVERY day an entry covers, not just the first and last: FindUs.astro computes contiguous runs from this, so a gap in the list correctly becomes two rows instead of one range claiming a day the restaurant is shut.

$socialComment: Order here is the order shown in the nav and the footer. `id` selects the icon in components/SocialLinks.astro — an id with no matching icon is skipped, so add the icon before adding the network.

seo.$comment: PLACEHOLDER — `url` must be the real production domain before launch (canonical, OG, sitemap and robots.txt all derive from it).
